name: bwoah-extension
description: Bwoah! - Your F1 Homepage: Up-to-date race schedules, leaderboards, and F1 images for enthusiasts.

scripts.build:chrome: mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/bwoah-chrome.zip manifest.json background.js newtab.html newtab.js js styles.css icons images jsons LICENSE README.md -x '*.DS_Store*'
scripts.build:firefox: mkdir -p dist && cp manifest.firefox.json manifest.temp.json && mv manifest.json manifest.chrome.json && mv manifest.temp.json manifest.json && zip -r dist/bwoah-firefox.zip manifest.json background.js newtab.html newtab.js js styles.css icons images jsons LICENSE README.md -x '*.DS_Store*' && mv manifest.json manifest.firefox.json && mv manifest.chrome.json manifest.json
scripts.build:zip: bun run build:chrome && bun run build:firefox
